caption: The drawing depicts a detailed graphite illustration of a cast iron trivet with a circular base and a handle. The trivet's base is composed of an openwork design featuring interlocking circular and curved shapes, forming a decorative pattern within the outer ring. The handle is solid, extending from one side of the trivet and ending in a rounded loop with an internal spiral. The trivet is supported by three short legs evenly spaced around the bottom edge. Above the main, more shaded rendering is a smaller technical drawing of the trivet in a lighter, less detailed style, accompanied by dimensional measurements indicating its length (10 1/2 inches), diameter (6 1/4 inches), and height (1 1/8 inches). To the far left, lightly sketched, is a heart shape containing a circle near its upper right curve. The drawing is executed on an off-white or slightly yellowed sheet of paper, and the color is predominantly shades of gray and black due to the pencil medium. The name "B. Bensive" is written in the lower left corner of the sheet.
title: Trivet
